sql = """
WITH siparis_tutarlari AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        s.id AS siparis_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS tutar
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.id, m.sehir
),
sirali_tutarlar AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        tutar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sehir ORDER BY tutar) as row_asc,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sehir) as toplam_sayi
    FROM siparis_tutarlari
),
medyan_hesaplama AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        AVG(tutar) as medyan
    FROM sirali_tutarlar
    WHERE row_asc IN (
        SELECT CAST((toplam_sayi + 1) / 2.0 AS INTEGER) FROM sirali_tutarlar GROUP BY sehir
    ) OR row_asc IN (
        SELECT CAST((toplam_sayi + 2) / 2.0 AS INTEGER) FROM sirali_tutarlar GROUP BY sehir
    )
    GROUP BY sehir
),
istatistikler AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        COUNT(*) as siparis_sayisi
    FROM siparis_tutarlari
    GROUP BY sehir
)
SELECT 
    i.sehir,
    i.siparis_sayisi,
    ROUND(m.medyan, 2) as medyan
FROM istatistikler i
JOIN medyan_hesaplama m ON i.sehir = m.sehir
WHERE i.siparis_sayisi >= 2
ORDER BY medyan DESC, i.sehir ASC;
"""

test_query(sql)
